name: vehicle-purchase-visual
description: Visual check: purchase vehicle deducts cost from cash, mesh appears in scene, fleet shows idle state. Vehicle purchases are made by clicking the dealership rows in the Fleet panel (issue #479), not by typing `vehicle buy`; the list/scores steps stay observation commands.

expect.note: real click on the Fleet panel's debris_hauler tier-1 row -- vehicle buy debris_hauler with no tier: arg defaults to tier 1 too (parseVehicleTierArg, vehicle.ts), so command mode and this click target the same purchase

steps.description: BLOCKED FINDING, left unconverted deliberately: no player can reach this state. After the hauler above, cash is short of a drill rig, so the Fleet panel correctly disables its buy button — but `vehicle buy` subtracts the cost unconditionally and drives cash negative, so command mode succeeds where the UI refuses. `research queue`, `employee train` and `survey` all reject an unaffordable purchase; `vehicle buy`, `employee hire` and `build` do not. Filed as a separate finding rather than papered over with a click that cannot land (.claude/rules/playability.md).

expect.note: left as a command deliberately (see this step's own description) -- the Fleet panel disables the drill_rig buy button once cash can't cover it, but `vehicle buy` itself has no affordability guard and drives cash negative; asserting the real, uncapped consequence rather than a state no player could reach
